tldr: Evening batch (Sep 6) — the week's heaviest stories get their health-and-safety edges. Psychiatry researchers push for an 'AI-associated psychosis' clinical diagnosis (KCL/UCL; OpenAI self-reports ~560K users/week showing psychosis or mania signs) — a documented harm vector for anyone shipping companion agents. OpenAI dev Thibault Sottiaux says pre-GA Astra was 'probably our biggest competitive advantage', pulling internal plans forward six months to ship at DevDay. Abliteration.ai turns guardrail-stripping into a turnkey paid service on open-weight GLM-5.3 — journalists generated malware instructions without restriction. Fresh model drops: Google's WeatherNext 3 learns weather directly from live satellite data (no physics sims, 5km hourly forecasts), Lyria 3.5 brings music generation into the Gemini app, and Meta Superintelligence Labs' Muse Voice Transcribe does 80ms-chunk real-time streaming transcription with speaker separation. Gemini Spark expands to managing your Google Photos library. Hermes Agent adds per-model provider pinning for OpenRouter. YC announces an 'Own Your Intelligence' hackathon (Sep 27, SF).

articles.title: Psychiatry debates whether 'AI-associated psychosis' should be a diagnosis
articles.summary: KCL/UCL argue heavy chatbot use can trigger psychotic symptoms; OpenAI self-reports ~560K users/week showing signs — an 'echo chamber of one'.

articles.title: OpenAI developer: Astra pulled internal plans forward by six months
articles.summary: Sottiaux calls pre-GA Astra OpenAI's 'biggest competitive advantage' — internal use moved some roadmap plans up six months to DevDay.

articles.title: Stripping safety guardrails from open-weight models is now a turnkey service
articles.summary: Abliteration.ai sells refusal-free open-weight GLM-5.3 access for red teams — journalists generated password-stealer code and a pathogen protocol unrestrained.

articles.title: Google's WeatherNext 3 learns weather directly from live satellite data
articles.summary: Google Research/DeepMind drop physics simulations for live satellite learning — hourly forecasts up to 5km resolution.

articles.title: Google's Lyria 3.5 music model lands in the Gemini app and API
articles.summary: More expressive vocals and richer arrangements — available via Gemini, Flow Music, AI Studio and Google Vids; Google says trained only on licensed content.

articles.title: Meta's Muse Voice Transcribe: real-time audio for assistants that never stop listening
articles.summary: Meta's streaming transcription processes speech in 80ms chunks, separates speakers, detects sentence boundaries — most accurate per Artificial Analysis.

articles.title: Gemini Spark can now manage your Google Photos library
articles.summary: Google's personal agent searches, curates, edits and shares photos, runs recurring workflows — edits save as new copies, originals untouched.

articles.title: Hermes Agent adds per-model provider pinning for OpenRouter
articles.summary: Constrain specific models to specific OpenRouter providers without a global lock — tighter cost/routing control for multi-provider agent runs.

articles.title: LLMs as a Cognitive Virus — arxiv paper models AI dependence as an epidemic
articles.summary: Epidemiological math for LLM adoption — uncoupled/coupled/dependent users, tipping points, 'cognitive immunization'; 237-pt HN discussion pushed back.

articles.title: YC announces 'Own Your Intelligence' hackathon — agents, models and memory
articles.summary: Garry Tan: build and own your own agent, models and memory — YC hackathon Sep 27 in SF; a signal YC's agent thesis is moving to owning the full stack.
